purpose: Bounded preflight projection for the homepage-video runtime and GitHub required-status learnings; full evidence remains in the two canonical learning records.

lessons.prevention: Treat hero-video playback as a runtime lifecycle contract; static autoplay attributes are insufficient without recovery and browser regression evidence.

If exact-head test is green but GitHub says the required check is expected on a synthetic merge ref, do not rerun substantive tests or disable the required check; diagnose provider/ref association first.
